summary.text: Joshua Parks is the Libertarian candidate for the South Carolina House of Representatives, District 75, in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the Libertarian Party convention on April 11, 2026.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a fiscally conservative libertarian running in his first political race.

paragraphs.text: Joshua Parks graduated from Lexington High School and earned a bachelor's degree from Winthrop University in 2005 and a graduate degree from Columbia International University in 2022.
His career experience includes working in consulting.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Parks said his campaign focuses on reducing government overreach, spending, waste, corruption and taxes.

He listed three key messages: reducing taxes and spending, including eliminating income taxes; making South Carolina the most small-business-friendly state in the country; and fixing infrastructure, especially roads.
